essence: Offering the oblation must be followed by praising and bowing to the deity.
One should smear the oblation ash while conjoining it with mantra and meditation.
The bali may be given at the oblation's end or otherwise as stated.
One should worship with fragrance, flowers, and so forth, continuing up to the bali offering.
The bali should be pure food mixed with ghee and accompanied by curd, cakes, and so forth.
